verdict.rationale: Poly ships an in-product agent that sees the file or folder you're viewing and can summarize, explain, or edit it. It also runs multi-step tasks such as extracting structured data from invoices, and Poly Mind automatically builds a memory 'second brain' from your files. That delivers AI-generated insights from your data inside the product. missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted suggestions and recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The agent sees what you see, so you can ask it about the file you're reading, or the folder you're browsing. Ask it to summarize, explain, or even edit your files.
The Poly agent can handle tasks that span multiple steps — reading, searching, writing, and organizing — in a single request.
Poly automatically remembers key details, forming a "second brain" for you out of your files.
Store, browse, research, and organize your files with A.I. — available on web and desktop
